title: TerraFusion Runtime Certification Spec
description: Deterministic expectations for runtime certification against runtimecontract.v1

checks.name: Readiness Endpoint
checks.description: Readiness must return 200 when constitutional flags are true

checks.name: Proof Endpoint
checks.description: Proof endpoint must return deterministic JSON with all required fields

checks.name: Proof Determinism
checks.description: Proof response keys must be lexicographically sorted for determinism

checks.name: SHA-256 Format
checks.description: manifest_sha256 must be lowercase hex (64 characters)

checks.name: SpecLock Status
checks.description: speclock_ok must be true for constitutional compliance

checks.name: State Mesh Status
checks.description: state_mesh_ok must be true for constitutional compliance

checks.name: Metrics Endpoint
checks.description: Prometheus metrics endpoint must expose required constitutional metrics

checks.name: SpecLock API
checks.description: SpecLock governance API must be accessible

checks.name: SpecLock Proof
checks.description: SpecLock proof endpoint for governance verification

checks.name: State Proof
checks.description: State mesh proof endpoint for federation verification

exit_codes.1: CERTIFICATION_FAILED - one or more checks failed
